title.zh: 巴拿马运河临时竞拍价创纪录；8.15 起吃水降至 48.5 英尺
title.en: Panama Canal auction slots hit records; max draft cut to 48.5 ft from Aug 15

desc.zh: 8 月 11 日前后一艘集装箱船在巴拿马运河临时竞拍中以约 400 万美元成交；8 月常规船闸日均竞拍均价升至约 110 万美元，是去年同期的 16 倍以上。8 月 15 日起运河吃水深度进一步降至 48.5 英尺，马士基、赫伯罗特、ONE 等已陆续加征运河与旺季附加费。需求端受中东地缘风险与霍尔木兹通航不稳推升，近三成运河货运现需通过竞拍争抢通行名额。
desc.en: Around Aug 11 a containership paid a record ~$4M in a Panama Canal auction slot; August's daily average auction price for conventional locks has climbed to ~$1.1M, over 16x the year-ago level. Effective Aug 15, the canal's max draft drops further to 48.5 ft, with Maersk, Hapag-Lloyd and ONE adding canal and peak surcharges. Geopolitical risk in the Middle East and unstable Hormuz transits are pushing operators to pay up for certainty — nearly 30% of canal cargo now moves via auctioned slots.

title.zh: 美国对进口无人机及零部件开征 10%–100% 关税，9 月 3 日生效
title.en: US imposes 10–100% tariff on imported drones and components, effective Sept 3

desc.zh: 8 月 13 日特朗普签署公告，以国家安全为由对进口无人机及零部件开征 10%–100% 从价关税：>25kg 且具备热成像等高度敏感的整机、停靠站及关键组件税率 100%；较小且非特定功能整机及组件 25%；来自欧盟、日本、韩国、瑞士、列支敦士登及中国台湾地区上限 15%；英国上限 10%（须证明关键部件源自美及上述地区）。整体关税自签署 21 天后即 2026 年 9 月 3 日生效，非高度敏感组件延至 180 天后实施，公告同时授权美商务部长建立无人机制造回流激励程序。
desc.en: On Aug 13, President Trump signed a proclamation citing national security to impose 10–100% ad valorem tariffs on imported drones and components: highly sensitive units (>25 kg with thermal imaging etc.) and stations/key parts at 100%; smaller non-sensitive units and parts at 25%; imports from the EU, Japan, South Korea, Switzerland, Liechtenstein and Taiwan capped at 15%; UK at 10% (subject to proof of US-aligned origin). Duties take effect Sept 3 (21 days after signing); non-sensitive components are phased in 180 days later. The order also authorizes a Commerce-led reshoring incentive program.

title.zh: 德国电池巨头 VARTA 破产：苹果 AirPods 电池订单转向中国，欧洲电池制造业结构性困境凸显
title.en: German battery giant VARTA files insolvency; Apple shifts AirPods cells to China

desc.zh: 7 月底拥有 139 年历史的 VARTA 因失去苹果订单进入自主管理破产程序：苹果 2026 年 5 月决定 AirPods CoinPower 电池转向中国供应商（亿纬锂能/欣旺达报价 $1.5–$2/颗，对 VARTA 的 $4–$5），现有合同 10 月到期不续。保时捷与大股东 Michael Tojner 拒绝追加注资；诺德林根约 350 人的工厂 2026 年秋关闭。欧洲电池企业普遍存在客户高度集中、产能偏小、面对亚洲供应链价格劣势的结构性问题——Britishvolt、Northvolt 等接连倒下。
desc.en: 139-year-old VARTA entered self-administered insolvency at end-July after losing Apple: Apple decided in May 2026 to shift AirPods CoinPower cell sourcing to Chinese suppliers (EVE Energy/Sunwoda at $1.5–2/unit vs. VARTA's $4–5), with the existing contract ending Oct 2026 non-renewed. Porsche and major shareholder Michael Tojner refused further capital; the ~350-employee Nördlingen plant will close in autumn 2026. The case exposes structural European battery-industry weaknesses — concentrated customers, sub-scale capacity, price disadvantage vs. Asian supply chains — following Britishvolt, Northvolt and others.

title.zh: Drewry WCI 升至 $4,339/FEU（+1%），跨太平洋航线领涨
title.en: Drewry WCI rises to $4,339/FEU (+1%), led by Transpacific

desc.zh: 德鲁里 8 月 13 日数据显示 WCI 周环比上涨 1% 至 $4,339/40ft，跨太平洋航线拉动：上海—纽约 +10% 至 $8,706/FEU、上海—洛杉矶 +6% 至 $6,244/FEU；运力端本周取消 10 个航次、下周计划再取消 7 个。亚欧航线则小幅回落：上海—热那亚 −8% 至 $5,080、上海—鹿特丹 −5% 至 $4,425。承运人维持运力管理，预期下周运价趋稳。报告同时提示：9 月巴拿马运河水位预计再降，部分承运人已公布 9 月生效的巴拿马附加费，将进一步约束美东/墨湾舱位。
desc.en: Drewry's Aug 13 WCI rose 1% w/w to $4,339/40 ft, led by Transpacific: Shanghai–New York +10% to $8,706/FEU, Shanghai–LA +6% to $6,244/FEU; carriers blanked 10 sailings this week and plan 7 more next week. Asia–Europe softened: Shanghai–Genoa −8% to $5,080, Shanghai–Rotterdam −5% to $4,425. Capacity stays managed and rates are expected steady next week. The report also flags Panama Canal water levels set to drop again in September, with carriers announcing Sept-effective canal surcharges that will further constrain USEC/Gulf space.

title.zh: 华强北 AI 硬件出口爆发：1-7月销售额 +55%，AI 产品占商圈比重 41%→61%
title.en: Huaqiangbei AI hardware exports surge: Jan-Jul sales +55%, AI share of the district 41%→61%

desc.zh: 华强北街道：日均 8,000 名外籍客商采购；AI 产品占商圈内电子产品比重由 2025 年 41% 大幅跃升至 61%；1-7 月 AI 产品全品类销售额同比增长 55% 以上（AI 眼镜销量 +100%、无人机/机器人 +60–70%）。深圳海关：上半年高新技术产品进出口 1.7 万亿元（全国第一），AI 相关产品进出口额突破万亿、增速超 50%。欧盟 7/14 豁免可穿戴设备可拆卸电池强制要求，进一步降低成本。「一公里产业链」100+ 元器件 1 天配齐、1 周出样，AI 产品出口覆盖全球 190+ 国家和地区。
desc.en: Huaqiangbei Subdistrict: ~8,000 foreign buyers daily; AI products' share of district electronics jumped from 41% (2025) to 61% (Jul 2026); Jan-Jul AI product sales up 55%+ YoY (AI glasses +100%, drones/robots +60-70%). Shenzhen Customs: H1 high-tech product import/export reached CNY 1.7T (national #1), with AI-related products exceeding CNY 1T and growing >50%. The EU's Jul 14 exemption on detachable-battery requirements for wearables further cut costs. The 'one-kilometer supply chain' can source 100+ components in a day and produce samples in a week; AI products now ship to 190+ countries and territories.

title.zh: 国家邮政局：1-7月寄递量 +4.2%、日均 5.5 亿件，快递业从「末端配送」向「前端供应链」延伸
title.en: State Post Bureau: Jan-Jul delivery volume +4.2%, daily ~550M parcels; express sector extends from last-mile to upstream supply chain

desc.zh: 国家邮政局 8/15：1-7 月邮政行业寄递业务量累计完成 1,274.4 亿件（+4.2%），业务收入（不含储蓄银行直接营业收入）累计完成 10,799.1 亿元（+6.1%），双增长。快递业加速从「末端配送」向「前端供应链」延伸，以数智物流创新赋能特色产业。沈阳案例：快递企业与汽车零部件厂驻场合作，配送时效从「按天计」提升至「按小时计」，高峰时段整车直发。国家邮政局发展研究中心王岳含：日均业务量约 5.5 亿件，通过定制化、精细化服务满足多元消费需求。
desc.en: State Post Bureau Aug 15: Jan-Jul postal delivery volume reached 127.44B parcels (+4.2%), revenue (excl. postal savings bank direct ops) CNY 1,079.91B (+6.1%) — double-digit growth on both counts. The express sector is accelerating its shift from last-mile delivery toward upstream supply chain services, using digital-smart logistics to empower specialized industries. In Shenyang, courier firms run on-site partnerships with auto-parts makers, upgrading delivery from 'by the day' to 'by the hour' with full-truck direct dispatch at peak. Wang Yuehan (State Post Bureau Development Research Center): daily volume ~550M parcels, with customized, refined services meeting diverse consumer demand.

title.zh: 霍尔木兹海峡日均通行降至战前约十分之一，结构性冲击蔓延
title.en: Hormuz daily transits fall to ~10% of pre-war; shock now structural

desc.zh: Xeneta 数据显示霍尔木兹海峡日集装箱船通行量自 7 月中旬以来稳定在十几艘左右，约为战前水平的十分之一；日通行区间 0–2 艘。马士基对通过霍尔木兹海峡的船舶加收 $1,000/箱附加费；达飞 EFS $75–$165/TEU 自 8/1 生效；ONE EFS $38–$100/TEU 自今日（8/15）生效。8 月 12 日美、伊、阿曼三方据报正推进 60 天临时通航方案（分道通行、免收通行费），但航道管辖权与细则仍存分歧，尚无约束性文件落地。
desc.en: Xeneta reports Hormuz container-ship daily transits have been stuck in the teens since mid-July — roughly 10% of pre-war levels — with daily counts of 0–2 vessels. Maersk is charging $1,000/box for Hormuz transits; CMA CGG EFS $75–$165/TEU from Aug 1; ONE EFS $38–$100/TEU effective today (Aug 15). A US–Iran–Oman 60-day interim transit scheme (lane separation, no transit fee) was reported Aug 12, but disputes over corridor control and rules remain unresolved.

title.zh: 8 月班轮公司密集加征附加费：ONE EFS 今日起、MSC PCS 8/19 生效
title.en: Carriers stack August surcharges: ONE EFS today; MSC PCS Aug 19

desc.zh: 多家头部班轮公司 8 月密集调整附加费：ONE 紧急燃油附加费（EFS）自 2026 年 8 月 15 日起对所有远洋干线及区域内支线征 $38–$100/TEU；达飞 EFS 自 8 月 1 日起征 $75–$165/TEU；MSC 自 8 月 19 日起对东南亚、中国、韩国、日本起运至美国东海岸、墨湾的货物征巴拿马运河附加费（PCS）$100/TEU；马士基对通过霍尔木兹海峡的船舶征 $1,000/箱。叠加 MSC 8/15 起生效的远东—欧洲新 FAK 费率（北欧 $5,100/$7,800，西地中海 $4,900/$6,700），全包成本压力继续向货主传导。
desc.en: Major liners stacked August surcharges: ONE EFS at $38–$100/TEU effective today (Aug 15) on all deep-sea and intra-regional trades; CMA CGG EFS $75–$165/TEU from Aug 1; MSC Panama Canal Surcharge $100/TEU from Aug 19 for cargo from SE Asia, China, Korea and Japan to the US East Coast and Gulf; Maersk at $1,000/box for Hormuz transits. Combined with MSC's new Far East→Europe FAK rates effective Aug 15 (N. Europe $5,100/$7,800, W. Med $4,900/$6,700), all-in cost pressure continues to pass through to cargo owners.

title.zh: 新能源重卡加速渗透：H1 销量 +78.6%，厦门港渗透率 >30%，从港口短倒迈向干线
title.en: China NEV heavy-trucks surge: H1 sales +78.6%, Xiamen port >30%, expanding to trunk lanes

desc.zh: 央广网 8/7：上半年新能源重卡累计销量约 14 万辆，同比 +78.6%；厦门港港区内部短驳渗透率突破 30%，头部港运车队电动化率超 50%。8/15 起新能源重卡启用独立 HS 编码 87042390，出口退税率从 9% 上调至 13%。场景从港口/矿区封闭区域向干线延伸——部分车型已运营 1000+ 公里长途干线；河北辛集星耀物流 700 余台新能源车 + 整合社会运力 2000 余台，年减碳 46.8 万吨，构建「路港车网储电」零碳走廊。
desc.en: CNR Aug 7: H1 NEV heavy-truck sales ~140k units, +78.6% YoY; Xiamen port intra-terminal short-haul NEV penetration >30%, leading fleet electrification >50%. From Aug 15, NEV heavy trucks gain a dedicated HS code 87042390, with export tax rebate raised from 9% to 13%. Use cases are expanding from closed port/mine sites into trunk lanes — some models have run >1,000 km trunk routes; Hebei Xinji's Xingyao Logistics runs 700+ NEV trucks + 2,000+ integrated social capacity, cutting 468k tons of CO2/year via a road-port-vehicle-network-storage-power zero-carbon corridor.

title.zh: 供应链 AI 进入执行层：科捷联合方案落地、Kinaxis/IDC 称 41% 预期规模化自主运营
title.en: Supply-chain AI moves into execution: Kejie live; Kinaxis/IDC flag 41% autonomous target

desc.zh: 8 月 5 日神州控股科捷 CTO 张虎坡透露：AI 已进入供应链执行层，可在采购、调拨、订单调度、包材选择上给出可直接指导操作的具体决策；科捷 AI 智能体 + 具身智能机器人协同方案已在仓库运行 3 个月，单仓完成单量占比 10%，一家大客户包材年节省达整体成本约 27%（百万级）。8 月 12 日 Kinaxis 赞助的 IDC 研究显示：41% 受访者预期 1–2 年内实现规模化自主运营，但仅 12% 已将治理机制融入日常，52% 将信任列为首要障碍。同日京东工业与永钢集团签署战略合作，共建钢铁采购供应链数智化。
desc.en: On Aug 5, Digital China Kejie CTO Zhang Hupo said supply-chain AI has moved into execution — issuing directly actionable recommendations for procurement, allocation, order dispatch and packaging; Kejie's AI-agent + embodied-robot warehouse solution has run for 3 months and handles 10% of one DC's volume, saving one large customer ~27% (millions CNY) in annual packaging cost. On Aug 12, an IDC study sponsored by Kinaxis found 41% of supply-chain leaders expect scaled autonomous operations within 1–2 years — but only 12% have governance baked in, and 52% cite trust as the top barrier. Same day JD Industrial signed a strategic partnership with Yongsteel Group on procurement digitalization.

title.zh: MG Ship 推出 AI 多式联运追踪平台：覆盖 220 国、ETA 99%，打通在途库存融资
title.en: MG Ship launches AI multimodal tracking: 220+ countries, 99% ETA, in-transit financing

desc.zh: 新加坡物流科技公司 MG Ship 8/3 全球发布、8/10 正式登陆欧洲的 AI 多式联运追踪平台，将海/空/陆/包裹数据整合到统一控制塔，覆盖 220+ 国家、1,000+ 承运商与海关系统；ETA 准确率 99%，并基于运输与海关数据为企业提供在途库存融资。CEO 张淑明：65%+ 货运跟踪在货代/3PL 仍依赖人工——是行业最大效率缺口。公司同时推出 EEAP 企业早期体验计划，提供 60 天免费试用。
desc.en: Singapore logistics-tech MG Ship on Aug 3 globally launched (Aug 10 European rollout) its AI multimodal tracking platform, unifying sea/air/land/parcel data in a single control tower across 220+ countries and 1,000+ carrier and customs integrations; ETA accuracy 99%, with in-transit inventory financing built on consolidated shipment and customs data. CEO Suki Cheung: 65%+ of cargo-tracking activity at forwarders/3PLs is still manual — the industry's biggest efficiency gap. A 60-day Enterprise Early Access Program (EEAP) free trial is open through August–September 2026.
